scope: setup and workspace experience hardening around the unchanged Scion V0.16.50 semantic compiler

findings: A stale FeatureSelect chunk triggered the expected one-time app refresh but lost the selected example and course brief.
The visible 9% aggregate build number was ambiguous beside a separate 58% model-download number.
Recommended set looked active before it was selected, and lesson selectors exposed no aria-pressed state.
Scion setup information used warning color even though configuration was valid.
The quality report looked modal but exposed no dialog semantics or Escape close behavior.
The course-map Review starter went to advisory generation, returned malformed acknowledgment text, and performed no audit.
The voice pass spent a provider call on a surface already scoring texture 100 and then reverted because the score could not improve.

releaseCandidateReplay.browser: Chrome through the Codex in-app browser controller
checks: A forced reload from FeatureSelect resumed at Choose materials and retained the General Chemistry course brief.
Recommended set exposed aria-pressed=false before selection and true after the exact five-material preset was applied.
Specific lessons and lesson buttons exposed real pressed state before and after selecting lessons 1 and 2.
The Scion generation boundary rendered as an informational note.
The phone onboarding, materials, and generation screens introduced no horizontal document overflow.
The phone materials CTA remained on one deliberate line and the attachment helper stacked without collision.

modelBoundary.claim: compiler, orchestration, accessibility, efficiency, and workflow-trust improvement only
